identity.description: An interactive logon using a local administrator account that is not commonly seen on this host triggers the ABIOC 'A rare local administrator login'. The attack simulates a legitimate login followed by privilege escalation via a malicious binary execution.

manual_steps: Not authored. Write and test cleanup before promotion.

biocs.name: Rare Local Admin Login
biocs.description: Interactive logon with a local admin account not seen on host
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.AUTHENTICATION and event_sub_type = ENUM.AUTH_LOGIN
| filter actor_user_name = 'Administrator' and actor_user_domain = 'LOCAL'
| filter not in(actor_user_name, (select distinct actor_user_name from xdr_data where event_type = ENUM.AUTHENTICATION and event_sub_type = ENUM.AUTH_LOGIN and agent_hostname = 'target-host'))
